title: CQRS Basics
description: Separate read and write models for better scalability and clarity.

data.text:
**CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation)**

Splits operations that read data (queries) from operations that write data (commands). Each side can use a different model optimized for its job.

items: Write model is domain-rich and consistent
Usually uses a normalized relational database
Queries return DTOs optimized for the UI
Often uses a separate read database or cache
Eventual consistency between read and write models

data.title: When to Use CQRS
data.text: CQRS adds complexity. Start with it when you have distinct read/write workloads, need independent scaling, or have complex domain logic.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Commands write, Queries read — separate models
MediatR makes CQRS easy to implement
data.takeaway: Enterprise patterns help build maintainable, scalable systems.
